title: unitUid
responsibility: Reads and writes the stable uid a unit's source files announce in their first lines.

inputs.name: readUid.code
inputs.description: Source text to scan for a Harness UID annotation. Only its first 1000 characters are searched, and a match must contain @harness-uid, whitespace, u_ plus 10 lowercase base32 characters, and no lowercase base32 character immediately after the UID.

inputs.name: uidComment.path
inputs.description: Repository path used to choose the comment syntax or suppress a comment. Exact paths in the embedded-file set and paths ending in /atoms/Html<alphanumerics>.svelte or /atoms/Svg<alphanumerics>.svelte suppress comments; other .svelte, .js/.jsx/.ts/.tsx and .m/.c variants, or .css paths select HTML, line, or block comments.

inputs.name: uidComment.uid
inputs.description: UID text placed verbatim after @harness-uid in the selected comment. This function does not validate its format or escape it for the comment syntax.

inputs.name: withUid.path
inputs.description: Repository path used to select a comment syntax and insertion point. Canonical native atoms and the listed embedded paths have no inserted UID comment; unsupported extensions are unchanged.

inputs.name: withUid.code
inputs.description: Current file text to update when the path has a comment style and no UID annotation matches within its first 1000 characters. Insertion uses LF-separated lines, after an initial shebang and, for Svelte files, after leading Harness comment lines.

inputs.name: withUid.uid
inputs.description: UID text placed verbatim after @harness-uid in the selected comment. This function does not validate its format or escape it for the comment syntax.

outputs.name: readUid
outputs.description: The UID token captured from the first matching annotation within the first 1000 characters, or undefined when no annotation matches. A match has u_ followed by 10 lowercase base32 characters, with no lowercase base32 character immediately after them.

outputs.name: uidComment
outputs.description: One Harness UID comment in HTML syntax for non-canonical Svelte paths, line-comment syntax for JS/TS-family paths, or block-comment syntax for CSS paths. Returns undefined for canonical native atoms, listed embedded files, and paths without a recognized extension.

outputs.name: withUid
outputs.description: The file text with the selected UID comment inserted as one line after an initial shebang, or after leading Harness comment lines for Svelte files. If no comment applies or a UID is already found in the first 1000 characters, the input text is returned unchanged.
